verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs explicitly address AI agents and point them to https://docs.mercury.com/llms.txt, a Markdown index of all pages, and say any doc page can be fetched as Markdown by appending .md. A live probe confirmed llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with that content, and an official Agent Skills repo (SKILL.md files) adds agent-oriented guidance. Missing for 10: a publicly downloadable OpenAPI spec (the docs say endpoints are available in OpenAPI, but every conventional spec path returns 404 and the spec is set to admin-only), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually using llms.txt.
